articles.title_en: Spurs agree £52m Van Hecke deal with Brighton
articles.title_ja: Spurs agree £52m Van Hecke deal with ブライトン
articles.summary_ja: Netherlands World Cup defender ヤン・パウル・ファン・ヘッケ is set to leave ブライトン for Tottenham Hotspur after the two clubs agree a £52m deal.
